zoo.item.objects365-yolo26s: Objects365 YOLO26s (365 everyday objects, more accurate)
zoo.dialog.title: Download
zoo.err.not_published: "{name}" is not available for download yet.
zoo.err.not_published_hint: Ask your teacher to update EdgeLens, or to give you the offline model pack.
zoo.err.unknown_pack: "{name}" is not a model pack this version of EdgeLens recognizes.
zoo.err.unknown_pack_hint: Make sure the file downloaded completely, was not modified, and came from the download link of the same EdgeLens version.
zoo.err.no_space: Not enough disk space: about {need} MB needed, only {free} MB free.
zoo.err.no_space_hint: Delete some files you no longer need and try again.
zoo.err.http_hint: The file may not be uploaded yet or its address changed. Ask your teacher, or use the offline model pack.
zoo.err.network_hint: Check that this computer is online and try again. If the school network blocks downloads, ask your teacher for the offline model pack.
zoo.err.checksum: The downloaded "{name}" is incomplete or was modified.
zoo.err.checksum_hint: Download it again. If it keeps failing, ask your teacher for the offline model pack.
zoo.err.bad_zip: "{name}" is not a valid model pack.
